workingTree.byteEncoding: Fixed-width decimal strings avoid changing the measured manifest length when filling this receipt.
workingTree.method: HEAD git ls-tree -r -l logical blob totals, minus original bytes of changed/deleted tracked paths, plus their working bytes and the sole new manifest. All changed paths confined to the plan. Ignored/untracked scratch, Git objects, dependencies and filesystem block allocation are excluded; symlink metadata outside the change stays at HEAD. No .fgos file is opened.

proofs.scope: Current working-path violations are expected until actual runner commit and separate L12-11 accounting; no clean-byte acceptance.
